## Problem Statement

A clear and concise description of the problem you want to solve. Ex: "I'm
always frustrated when [...]"

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you
have considered.

## Impact

use cases if possible.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, code examples, or references about the feature request
here.
